title: Ghost Cut – Or why Cut and Paste is broken everywhere
summary: A technical blog post exploring the fundamental problems and inconsistencies with cut and paste functionality across different computing environments, likely written from a terminal/TUI development perspective using Textual framework.
problem_solved: Explains why the standard cut-and-paste operation behaves inconsistently or fails across different systems and applications.
